articles.translated_content:
2025年下载量最高的手机游戏《Block Blast》将于下个月登陆Apple Arcade。

Block Blast+将于9月3日在苹果每月6.99美元的游戏订阅服务上推出，不含广告，也没有内购。

根据AppMagic的估计，Hungry Studio这款类似俄罗斯方块的网格消除益智游戏去年报告下载量达3.68亿次，轻松领先于Roblox估计的2.95亿次。它还在2026年继续占据月度下载榜首，累计安装量估计在7.25亿至8.68亿之间。

即使在Arcade之外，Block Blast也是一款免费、由广告支持的游戏，其内购收入微乎其微，庞大的下载基础主要来自印度尼西亚、美国、越南、巴西和印度。

同样在9月3日加入Arcade的还有Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+，这是Klemens Strasser的拼图式自然游戏，也是2025年App Store文化影响力奖的获得者；此外还有NFL Retro Bowl ’27、Coloring Games for Families+和Let’s Play Oink Games+。加入该服务的所有四款游戏都是此前已上线的免费游戏，它们将以移除广告和内购的形式在Apple Arcade上首发。

今年2月，彭博社报道称，腾讯有意收购Block Blast开发商Hungry Studio的一小部分股份。

总部位于香港的Hungry Studio最近表示，Block Blast的平均日用户达到7000万，平均月用户达到3亿。这高于该公司2024年12月报告的4000万日活跃用户和1.6亿月活跃用户。

Hungry Studio’s hit puzzler Block Blast is heading to Apple Arcade – Mobilegamer.biz

2025’s most downloaded mobile game Block Blast is coming to Apple Arcade next month.
Block Blast+ launches ad-free and without in-app purchases on Apple’s $6.99-a-month gaming subscription service on September 3.
Hungry Studio’s Tetris-like grid-clearing puzzler racked up
a reported 368m downloads last year
according to AppMagic estimates, comfortably ahead of Roblox’s estimated 295m. It has continued to top monthly download charts into 2026, too, with lifetime installs estimated to be anywhere from 725m to 868m.
Even outside of Arcade, Block Blast is a free, ad-supported game with negligible IAP revenue, and it built its huge download base largely across Indonesia, the US, Vietnam, Brazil and India.
Also joining Arcade on September 3 is Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+, Klemens Strasser’s jigsaw-style nature game and winner of a 2025 App Store Award for Cultural Impact, and NFL Retro Bowl ’27, Coloring Games for Families+ and Let’s Play Oink Games+. All four games being added to the service are pre-existing free to play games that will debut on Apple Arcade with their ads and IAPs removed.
Back in February, Bloomberg reported that
Tencent was interested in buying a small stake in Block Blast maker Hungry Studio.
Hong Kong-based
Hungry Studio said recently
that Block Blast hit 70m daily average users and 300m monthly average users. That’s up from 40m DAU and 160m MAU
reported by the company in December 2024

正文：
数据摘要：《Monopoly Go》网店蓬勃发展、《Pokémon Go》数据飙升、《Love and Deepspace》收入下滑等 – Mobilegamer.biz
跳到内容
每周三，我们都会将最新的数据、研究和财务业绩拆解成易于理解的内容。
继续阅读，获取你需要了解的关键数字，没有任何水分。
本专栏由
Xsolla
赞助，它可以帮助你创建一个无缝的在线商店，让网页购买快速产生新收入——从上线到后续运营。
点击此处开始。
《Monopoly Go》位居Sensor Tower美国网店收入榜榜首
根据
Sensor Tower的估算
，6月份《Monopoly Go》在美国的总收入达1.43亿美元，涵盖App Store、Google Play和其自有网店。其中5260万美元（超过三分之一）来自网店，2026年上半年网店收入增长41%，而应用内购收入下降了25%。
网店收入前五名的其余游戏包括《Pokémon Go》（3430万美元）、《Disney Solitaire》（2870万美元）、《Raid: Shadow Legends》（2640万美元）和《Slotomania Slots》（1800万美元）。
据估算，网店目前占社交博彩类游戏购买收入的比重已超过三分之一，较两年前的约十分之一大幅跃升，美国网店收入前十名中有六款是博彩类游戏。
类似的模式也出现在中重度游戏中：过去两年，米哈游在美国App Store的收入中已有相当大一部分转移到网店，尽管其在美国的整体购买收入仍在持续增长。
Sensor Tower表示，《Raid: Shadow Legends》玩家目前在美国的大部分支出已完全脱离应用商店，因此其总收入同比增长超过50%。
《Pokémon Go》十周年活动推动收入飙升
根据
Sensor Tower的估算
，《Pokémon Go》7月份月环比收入增加7370万美元，增幅达230%，其十周年活动带来了多年来最强劲的增长之一。
按发行商排名，腾讯以50.3亿美元（9.34亿次下载）领跑上半年移动游戏收入，其次是世纪天城（19.3亿美元）、Scopely（15.3亿美元）、微软（13.6亿美元）和Dream Games（12.3亿美元）。
《Love and Deepspace》因Valko争议后收入暴跌
Sensor Tower的估算显示，《Love and Deepspace》7月份在iOS和Google Play上的收入刚刚超过1000万美元，低于6月份的约3800万美元。
叠纸在遭到抵制后取消了原定的第六位男主，撤出了Bilibili World 2026的参展，并因Valko有争议的宣传物料而受到中国官方媒体和公安部的批评。
《Pixel Flow》以1.04亿美元领跑AppMagic上半年混合休闲益智榜单
根据
AppMagic
的最新估算，《Pixel Flow》在2026年上半年全球应用内购买收入达1.04亿美元，在其上线约一年后领跑混合休闲益智市场。
螺丝品类头部产品《Screwdom》收入4400万美元（700万次下载），方块益智头部产品《Color Block Jam》收入4200万美元（1200万次下载，排名较上期下降两位）。
前十名的其余产品同样分布在这三个子品类中。整理类：《Yarn Loop》（2100万美元）、《Marble Sort》（1500万美元）和《Knit Out》（800万美元，上升四位）。螺丝类：《Happy Screw Trip 3D》（1300万美元）和《Yarn Fever》（1000万美元）。方块类：《Gecko Out》（1600万美元）和《Hexa Away》（1000万美元）。
万代南梦宫发布创纪录的第一季度净销售额，但数字业务利润下降31%
万代南梦宫
公布
第一季度净销售额创纪录达20亿美元（3284亿日元），同比增长9.3%，主要由玩具与收藏品业务以及游乐设施业务带动。
其数字业务（主机游戏和手游）净销售额下降15.6%至5.73亿美元（909亿日元），营业利润下降30.9%至9450万美元（150亿日元），公司将其归因于发行排期较为清淡（两款游戏合计售出690万套主机游戏，而去年同期为15款游戏、1080万套）。
万代南梦宫表示，其核心移动应用在本季度“保持受欢迎”，并将上半财年数字业务预测上调10%至12亿美元（2000亿日元）——尽管这仍意味着同比下滑31.5%。
社交博彩市场降温，SciPlay收入下降9%至1.82亿美元
根据母公司Light & Wonder的最新财报，由于整体社交博彩市场走软，SciPlay第二季度收入
同比下降9%至1.82亿美元
。调整后EBITDA下降3%至7200万美元，但利润率仍扩大了300个基点，达到40%。
直营消费者收入持续增长，达到5300万美元（占SciPlay季度总收入的29%），而去年同期为3500万美元（17.5%）。
月均每付费用户收入同比增长4%至133.80美元，而平均付费用户数从51.2万降至44.7万。这些业绩公布之前，SciPlay
近期在其以色列开发中心进行了裁员
。

Every Wednesday we break down the latest data, research and financial results into digestible chunks.

Monopoly Go tops Sensor Tower’s US webshop revenue chart
Monopoly Go generated $143m in total US revenue in June across App Store, Google Play and its own webstore, according to
Sensor Tower estimates
. $52.6m of that revenue (over a third) came through the webstore alone, up 41% across H1 2026 even as store IAP fell 25%.
The rest of the top five earners by webshop revenue comprised of Pokémon Go ($34.3m), Disney Solitaire ($28.7m), Raid: Shadow Legends ($26.4m) and Slotomania Slots ($18m).
Webstores are thought to now account for well over a third of purchase revenue in the social casino genre specifically, a jump from roughly a tenth two years ago, and six of the top 10 US webstore earners are casino titles.
A similar pattern is showing up in midcore: Mihoyo has seen a sizeable chunk of its US app store revenue migrate to webstores over the past two years, even as its overall US purchase revenue kept growing.
Raid: Shadow Legends players now do most of their US spending outside app stores entirely, says Sensor Tower, with total revenue up over 50% year-on-year as a result.
Pokémon Go’s 10th anniversary event drives revenue jump
Pokémon Go added $73.7m month-on-month in July, a 230% jump, as its 10th-anniversary campaign drove one of its strongest lifts in years, per
Sensor Tower estimates
.
By publisher, Tencent led H1 mobile revenue at $5.03bn (934m downloads), ahead of Century Games ($1.93bn), Scopely ($1.53bn), Microsoft ($1.36bn) and Dream Games ($1.23bn).
Love and Deepspace’s revenue crashes after Valko backlash
Sensor Tower estimates suggest Love and Deepspace

Amazon 将撤回对 Lost Ark 和 Throne and Liberty 的发行商角色  
商务  
新闻  
Amazon 将于2027年初撤回其在 Lost Ark 和 Throne and Liberty 上的发行商角色。  
Amazon Games 正将这两款 MMO 交还给各自的开发商。  
Diego Argüello，新闻特约编辑，GameDeveloper.com  
2026年8月12日  
2分钟阅读  
图片来自 Smilegate RPG  

Amazon 正在与两款 MMO Lost Ark 和 Throne and Liberty 分道扬镳，将于2027年初将这两款游戏交还给各自的开发商。  

Amazon 于今日早些时候宣布，Throne and Liberty 的全球发行服务将在2026年第四季度末从 Amazon Game Studios 过渡到 NC 自有的在线发行服务。至于 Lost Ark，Amazon 将于2027年初结束其在线服务运营，由 Smilegate 接手后续工作。  

对于 Throne and Liberty，NC 正在与开发商 FirstSpark Games（也是 NC 旗下工作室）合作，将全球玩家统一到一项在线服务中。  

FirstSpark Games 首席执行官 Moonyoung Choi 在新闻稿中表示：“Amazon Game Studios 一直是非常出色的合作伙伴，我们很感激能与他们的团队一同推出并运营我们的 MMO 至今。在全球发行中扮演更直接的角色对我们来说意义重大，因此我们非常兴奋能以 NC 的身份直接领导 Throne and Liberty 的下一篇章。”  

相关：  
开发者预计生成式 AI 将在未来三年内影响职位和团队规模  

Smilegate 对 Lost Ark 表达了类似看法，称将游戏交还给开发者对玩家而言是一个“积极的结果”。  

Smilegate 的声明写道：“感谢这次合作中双方在幕后工作的每一位开发者、社区经理、支持专家、本地化专家和团队成员。你们的奉献、深夜加班和真挚热情成就了这款游戏。”  

尽管这两款游戏的服务将继续，但 Amazon 自己对 MMO 的投入程度却不那么确定。除前述作品外，该公司已于去年年底停止了 New World: Aeternum 的积极开发。  

据报道，时任 Amazon 音频、Twitch 和游戏业务副总裁的 Steve Boom 曾表示，公司做出了“艰难的决定，以中止我们大量第一方 AAA 游戏开发工作”，特别是在 Amazon Game Studios 内的 MMO 项目。在同一份发给员工的备忘录中，Boom 据称还提到 Throne and Liberty 和 Lost Ark 是其仍以发行商身份投入的 MMO。  

随着 Amazon Game Studios 负责人 Cristoph Hartmann 离职，该公司据称开始从 PC 和主机游戏领域撤退，转而支持 Luna。三个月后，公司宣布缩减该游戏服务的规模。  

这一消息发布之际，UGC 地牢格斗游戏 King of Meat 在运营六个月后关闭，Maverick Games 的一款即将推出的开放世界竞速游戏被抛弃，而 Embracer 旗下的 Crystal Dynamics 也持续裁员——Amazon 一直作为发行商与 Crystal Dynamics 合作推出即将推出的 Tomb Raider 游戏。

Diego Nicolás Argüello 是一位来自阿根廷的自由记者和评论家。电子游戏帮助他学会了英语，所以现在他为《纽约时报》、NPR、《滚石》等媒体撰写相关报道。他还运营着 Into the Spine，一个致力于培养和支持新作家的网站，并共同主持了 Turnabout Breakdown，一档关于 Ace Attorney 系列的播客。当你读到这段话时，他很可能正在玩一款节奏游戏。

on

Saber Interactive 否认在其即将推出的驾驶游戏《Rideshare Stimulator》中使用 ChatGPT 替代编剧。

这一否认是在 Stella Sacco 的公开指控之后做出的，她声称自己是该项目的首席编剧，并在开发中途被撤下。

Sacco 在领英上的资料显示，她于 2023 年 7 月至 2024 年 7 月担任 Saber 的首席编剧。她在 Bluesky 上写道：“我是这个游戏的首席编剧！Saber 在开发中途用 ChatGPT 替代了我。所有乘客的配音也都是 AI。要么他们在某个时候改变了方向，要么他们没有在 Steam 上披露这一点。”

Sacco 补充道：“当这道指令下达时，我警告过推动 AI 的 Matt Karch，玩家在 2023 年 12 月就讨厌 AI，等到游戏发售时他们会更讨厌。我告诉过他这种反弹会发生。他没有听我的，没有听我上司的，似乎根本没有听任何人的。”

作为回应，工作室告诉 PC Gamer：“无论是 Saber 还是 Unigine，都没有在《Rideshare》或任何其他游戏中使用 AI 替代编剧。事实上，自 2023 年以来，Saber 的编剧人员数量增至三倍。《Rideshare》的故事完全由真人撰写。

“游戏还将包含一个实验性的免费乘车模式，由于游戏中的乘客数量是无限的，因此该模式必然需要引入 AI。我们坚信使用 AI 工具来改善或增强游戏体验，并改进 NPC 行为，就像我们自 2001 年成立 Saber 以来一直做的那样。随着行业持续收缩，Saber 仍在继续招聘。我们 3000 多名员工中没有人需要担心被 AI 取代。”

然而，自从 Saber 发表声明以来，Sacco 一直坚持自己的说法。

“他们爱怎么说都行——我当时就在那里，我甚至当时在 Facebook 上发过帖子，而且我在 Bluesky 上多次提到过这件事，只是没有使用游戏的名称。

“他们把我从项目中撤下来，是为了使用 ChatGPT 来撰写其余文本，包括计划中的实时更新。如果他们在随后的几年里改变了计划，那很好，但再说一次：我当时就在那里，写这个游戏是我的工作，但在 Matt Karch 决定使用 ChatGPT 会给这个游戏带来很好的宣传效果之后，这就不是我的工作了。”

该游戏的 Steam 页面目前没有 AI 披露信息，尽管 Valve 要求开发者标注直接面向玩家的生成式 AI 内容。

今年早些时候，GamesIndustry.biz 推出了为期一周的 AI 主题内容，涵盖该技术是否对编程有用以及 AI 在游戏开发中的总体应用等话题。

In February 2025, the Dutch consumer rights organization Stichting Massaschade & Consument filed a class action lawsuit against Sony’s gaming division. A year and a half later, the authors of Stop Killing Games — an initiative for the preservation of games — agreed to join the case.

《Planet of Lana》的成功故事是一个战胜逆境的故事。但它也是一个天真稚嫩的故事。开发者们自己承认，他们最初并不知道自己在做什么。
这款2023年的平台跳跃游戏几乎违背了所有标准建议。瑞典开发商Wishfully Studios的首款游戏并没有像许多人建议的那样从小做起，而是直接投入了一款电影般的冒险游戏，耗时六年才完成。他们选择向发行商推销的类型也再饱和不过了。正如11-Bit Studios的Chris Wigley最近告诉GamesIndustry.biz的那样，“如果你做出一款出色的平台跳跃游戏并且它火了，它可以表现得非常好，但这类游戏太多了，想要脱颖而出极其困难。”
更糟糕的是，开发者的首个演示版本糟糕透顶，远未达到成功推销的通常要求。正如Wishfully的联合负责人兼创意总监Adam Stjärnljus在五月Nordic Game的演讲中所解释的那样，演示仅仅包含主角来回缓慢行走的画面。
Adam Stjärnljus
“感觉非常笨重，”他在演讲中解释道。“而且最重要的是，我们的制作计划也非常不切实际。所以我们基本上被发行商们批得体无完肤。”
“我们完全不知道自己在做什么，”游戏总监兼编剧Klas Martin Eriksson补充道。“我们就像在说，‘看，她在动。’”
Stjärnljus说他们进行了“数百次”推销，也收到了“数百次”拒绝。“有些是善意的‘不’，有些则不那么客气。但真的、真的很难。被人拒绝的感觉很糟糕。”
然而他们继续前行。只需一个人说“是”就够了。
（以及三年无薪工作。）
来点完全不同的东西
“回头看看，这非常天真，”Stjärnljus告诉GamesIndustry.biz。“但如果我们不天真，我们现在就不会在这里。所以这算是愚蠢和单纯想做出自己在意的东西的混合吧，我想。”
Stjärnljus有电影和广告背景，他和Eriksson以及首席游戏设计师Dan Faxe一起在斯德哥尔摩经营着电影制作公司Makers Only，制作企业影片和动画广告。Eriksson真正想做的是长片电影，但“广告似乎只是赚着做电影工作的钱的一种简单方式。”
《Planet of Lana》的幕后制作 | 开发者故事 | NG26
Stjärnljus和Eriksson在五月Nordic Game上就《Planet of Lana》的制作进行了演讲
在YouTube上观看
大约在2017年，Stjärnljus发现自己开始厌倦制作广告。“起初，制作这些广告非常激动人心，第一次你的广告出现在电视上时，那是巨大的成就。但随着岁月流逝，它越来越只是付房租的工作。”
Eriksson说他投入了大量时间和精力在广告工作上，但开始质疑那份热情是否投错了地方。“我当时在菲律宾拍摄，我就想，哦我的天，这太棒了，我可以旅行。我在这个片场，人们听我的话，这很好。但最后，这只是一个假牙粘合剂广告。如果你注定要精疲力尽，那还不如做你真正相信的事而耗尽自己。”
Stjärnljus决心尝试新事物，他认为自己在动画和电影方面的技能可以转化到游戏行业。“我真的很想做游戏，想看看如果我把我学到的一切用来做我真正在乎的东西，会发生什么，”他说。在他三十出头、第二个孩子出生后不久，他迈出了这一步。
《Planet of Lana》部分灵感来自1990年代的游戏《Oddworld》和《Another World》 | 图片来源：Wishfully/Thunderful Publishing
制作《Planet of Lana》意味着无偿工作，至少在最初是这样。Stjärnljus说，生活在瑞典使之成为可能。“我们这里有社会保障。我有一个支持我的妻子。所以有很多条件让我个人能够在没有薪水的情况下在这三年里花大量时间在《Planet of Lana》上。”瑞典的一个游戏加速器项目也帮了忙。“他们可以付钱让我们去参加会议进行推销，”他解释道。“我们没有得到任何用于实际开发的资金，但我们可以获得资金把游戏展示给发行商。”
Stjärnljus说他决心足够坚定，要把这件事坚持到底，即使这意味着得独自完成整个游戏，但他很快意识到，《Planet of Lana》有了更多人参与“会变得好得多”。他和妻子投入了全部积蓄——大约2万欧元（2.3万美元）——来支付一名自由动画师和一名兼职程序员的费用。
起点
在几乎其他一切之前，《Planet of Lana》先是Stjärnljus在Photoshop上创建的一幅图像，画面展现了Lana的……

How Planet of Lana became a hit through dogged determination after being rejected "hundreds" of times | GamesIndustry.biz

Read our editorial policy
.
The story of Planet of Lana is the story of triumph over adversity. But it's also one of naivety. The developers themselves admit they had no clue what they were doing at first.
The 2023 platformer goes against almost all standard guidance. Swedish developer Wishfully Studios didn't start small with its first ever game, as so many advise, instead going straight in with a cinematic adventure that took six years to complete. They couldn't have chosen a more over-saturated genre to pitch to publishers, either. As 11-Bit Studios' Chris Wigley
told
GamesIndustry.biz
recently
, "If you make a great platformer and it takes off, it can do amazingly well, but there's so many of them that it's extremely difficult to stand out."
On top of that, the developer's first demo was woefully inadequate, falling far short of what would typically be required for a successful pitch. As Wishfully co-head and creative director Adam Stjärnljus explained in a talk at
Nordic Game
in May, it simply consisted of the main character plodding back and forth.
Adam Stjärnljus
"It felt sluggish," he explained during the talk. "And on top of that, we also had a very unrealistic production plan. So we were basically slaughtered by publishers."
"We had no idea what we were doing," added game director and writer Klas Martin Eriksson. "We were just like, 'Look, she's moving'."
Stjärnljus said that they did "hundreds" of pitches and received "hundreds" of rejections. "Some of them were kind 'Nos' and some of them were not so kind. But it was really, really hard. It sucks to be told no."
Yet they kept going. All it took was for one person to say yes.
(And three years of unpaid work.)
Time for something completely different
"It was very naive, looking back," Stjärnljus tells
GamesIndustry.biz
. "But if we hadn't been naive, then we wouldn't be here now. So it's a mix of stupidity and just trying to build something you care about, I guess."
Stjärnljus comes from a background in film and advertising, and together with Eriksson and lead game designer Dan Faxe, he ran the film production company Makers Only in Stockholm, creating corporate films and animated commercials. Eriksson really wanted to make was feature films, but "commercials just seemed like an easy way to get paid to do the film stuff."
The Making of 'Planet of Lana' | Developer Stories | NG26
Stjärnljus and Eriksson gave a talk at Nordic Game in May about the making of Planet of Lana
Watch on YouTube
In around 2017, Stjärnljus found he was getting tired of making adverts. "In the beginning, it was very exciting doing these commercials, and the first time you had a commercial on TV, it was huge. But then as the years passed, it was more and more a job to pay the rent."
Eriksson says that he put huge amounts of time and effort into the commercial work, but started questioning whether that passion was misplaced. "I was shooting something in the Philippines and I was just like, oh my God, this is so amazing, I get to travel. I'm on this set and people listen to what I say, and it's great. But then at the end of the day, it was an ad for a denture adhesive. If you're going to get burnt out, you may as well get burnt out doing something that you really believe in."
Stjärnljus was determined to try something new, reckoning his skills in animation and film could translate to the games industry. "I really wanted to make games, and to see what could happen if I took everything I learned and actually had something that I cared about," he says. In his early thirties, not long after the birth of his second child, he made the leap.
Planet of Lana was partly inspired by the 1990s games Oddworld and Another World  |
Image credit:
Wishfully/Thunderful Publishing
Working on Planet of Lana meant working for nothing, at least at first. Stjärnljus says living in Sweden made it possible. "We have social security here. I had a wife that supported me. So there were a lot of things that enabled me personally to spend a lot of time [on Planet of Lana] during these three years without a salary." A Swedish game accelerator program helped, too. "They could pay us to go to conferences to pitch," he explains. "We didn't get any funding for actual development, but we could get funding to put the game in front of publishers."
Stjärnljus says he was determined enough to see the whole thing through, even if it meant making the whole game himself, but he quickly realised that Planet of Lana "was going to be immensely better with more people." He and his wife invested all of their savings – around €20,000 ($23,000) – to pay for a freelance animator and part-time programmer.
The starting point
Before almost anything else, Planet of Lana existed as an image Stjärnljus created on Photoshop, showing Lana and her creature companion Mui staring at a black, spider-like robot in an idyllic green field under blue skies. He was inspired by games like Another World, Limbo, Inside, and Oddworld, as well as by Studio Ghibli films like Spirited Away, Ponyo, and My Neighbour Totoro – and that initial image did a lot of heavy lifting. It was sufficiently inspiring to attract the attention of Takeshi Furukawa, who composed the score for The Last Guardian, and who came on board to write the music for Planet of Lana.
The 2017 Photoshop image that started it all  |
Image credit:
Wishfully/Thunderful Publishing
But although the image made waves on social media, it was far from enough to convince publishers. "The vision was good, but what they saw was we didn't have a realistic plan," says Stjärnljus. The timeline for completing a vertical slice was hopelessly optimistic, and all they had to show so far was a test of Lana running back and forth. "Then it was the realization that, okay, this doesn't work.

articles.translated_content:
2027年BAFTA游戏奖现已开放报名，同时更新了参赛要求、费用结构和AI政策。

BAFTA游戏委员会每年审查资格标准、投票和竞选规则。今年，规则手册已更新以澄清其对AI的处理方式，具体如下：

该奖项每年颁发，以表彰、尊重和奖励在创作、塑造和实现最终艺术成果方面做出杰出人类成就的个人，无论使用何种工具来实现这一成果。BAFTA是所有类别资格的仲裁者，并保留要求提供任何参赛作品额外信息的权利，这可能包括：
- 支持性署名信息
- 关于人类创造力和开发过程的支持性材料

BAFTA还对其参赛费用进行了多项调整，包括：
- 取消早鸟/发行当月折扣（此前为50%折扣）
- 为符合条件的独立和小型开发商引入25%的参赛费折扣
- 引入新的基础参赛费，涵盖参赛者选择的最多四个类别，并在适用情况下包括额外进入最佳游戏、英国游戏、主角演员和配角演员类别的费用
- 为Evolving Game类别引入降低的单一类别参赛费，以认识到此类参赛作品可能仅提交至一个类别
- 对超出基础参赛费范围的其他类别引入额外费用

Evolving Game类别现在将开放给全体成员在所有轮次中投票。提名和获奖者将由BAFTA成员决定，成员包括超过1,700名游戏专业人士和行业评审团。

BAFTA表示，这一变化将“使更广泛的行业专业知识和玩家视角得以参与，确保该类别保持相关性、稳健性，并反映当今游戏格局。”

2027年BAFTA游戏奖的资格窗口为2025年11月15日至2026年11月19日期间发布的游戏。

对于2025年11月15日至2026年7月31日期间发布的游戏，报名截止日期为9月18日。对于2026年8月1日至11月19日期间发布的游戏，报名截止日期为11月6日。

长名单将于2026年12月8日公布。提名将于2027年3月11日公布。

2027年BAFTA游戏奖将于2027年4月14日在伦敦举行。

去年，Sandfall Interactive的《Clair Obscur: Expedition 33》获得了三项BAFTA奖，包括最佳游戏和首秀游戏。

Entries for the 2027 BAFTA Games Awards are now open, alongside updates to its entry requirements, fee structure, and AI policy.
The BAFTA Games Committee reviews eligibility criteria, voting, and campaigning rules annually. This year, the
rulebook
has been updated to clarify its approach to AI, as follows:
The Awards are presented annually to recognise, honour and reward individuals for outstanding human achievement in originating, shaping and realising the final artistic outcome, regardless of the tools used to bring this work to life. BAFTA is the arbiter of all category eligibility and reserves the right to request additional information regarding any entry, this could include:
Supporting credit information
Supporting materials with regards to human creativity and development
BAFTA has also introduced several changes to its entry fees, including:
Removal of the Early Entry/Month of Release Discount (previously a 50% discount)
Introduction of a 25% discount on entry fees for eligible independent and small developers
Introduction of a new base entry fee covering entry into up to four categories of entrant's choice and will include additional entry into Best Game, British Game, Performer in a Leading Role and Performer in a Supporting Role, where applicable
Introduction of a reduced single-entry fee for Evolving Game, recognising that entries may only be submitted to one category
Introduction of an additional fee for categories entered beyond those included in the base entry fee
The Evolving Game category will now be open to a member-wide vote in all rounds. Nominations and the winner will be determined by BAFTA's membership, which includes over 1,700 games professionals and industry juries.
BAFTA said this change will "enable a broader range of industry expertise and player perspectives ensuring the category remains relevant, robust and reflective of today's games landscape."
The eligibility window for the 2027 BAFTA Games Awards is for games released between November 15, 2025 and November 19, 2026.
Entries close on September 18 for games released between November 15, 2025 and July 31, 2026. For games released between August 1 and November 19, 2026, entries close on November 6.
The longlist will be announced on December 8, 2026. Nominations will be announced on March 11, 2027.
The BAFTA Games Awards 2027 will take place in London on April 14, 2027.
Last year, Sandfall Interactive's
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 won three BAFTAs
, including Best Game and Debut Game.

Pearl Abyss 报告第二季度业绩疲软，因《Crimson Desert》三月发售的初期影响逐渐消退。
在第一季度收益飙升 419.8% 之后，营业收入和利润环比均出现下滑。
营业收入下降 41.4% 至 1926 亿韩元（1.359 亿美元），营业利润下降 68.1% 至 676 亿韩元（4770 万美元）。净利润也下降 58.3% 至 709 亿韩元（5000 万美元）。
该公司第二季度的业绩低于此前的指引，其归因于“《Crimson Desert》在各分销渠道的销售拆分、区域定价策略差异、实体版从售出到收入确认的时间滞后，以及退款保证相关的收入递延。”
按地区划分，北美和欧洲贡献了 75% 的收入，其次是亚洲占 16%，韩国占 9%。按平台划分，PC 占 61%，主机占 34%，移动端占 5%。主机占比保持高位，《Crimson Desert》约占总收入的 70%。
《Crimson Desert》在第二季度售出 211 万份，产生 1361 亿韩元（9600 万美元）收入。数字版占售出总份数的 82%，实体版占 18%。
Pearl Abyss 正在为这款开放世界 RPG 开发 DLC，发售日期将在第三季度公布。开发商还在拓展新平台，已在 Nintendo Switch 2 上达到“可玩基准”，目标是在 2027 年上半年推出。
《Black Desert》系列产生 550 亿韩元（3880 万美元）收入，略有下降，因为运营重点放在“内容优化而非大型扩展”上。
展望未来，Pearl Abyss 已更新全年指引。预计营业收入在 7098 亿韩元（5.01 亿美元）至 7438 亿韩元（5.25 亿美元）之间，营业利润预计在 3155 亿韩元（2.227 亿美元）至 3452 亿韩元（2.436 亿美元）之间。
两款新作《DokeV》和《Plan 8》正在开发中。《DokeV》计划于 2028 年下半年发售。Pearl Abyss 旨在为其游戏保持“每两到三年一个稳定的发售周期”。

Pearl Abyss Q2 earnings decline as impact of Crimson Desert's launch period subsides | GamesIndustry.biz

Read our editorial policy

Pearl Abyss reported a weaker second quarter as the initial impact of Crimson Desert's March launch tapered off.
Operating revenue and profit declined quarter-on-quarter after
a 419.8% surge in first-quarter earnings
.
Operating revenue was down 41.4% to ₩192.6 billion ($135.9 million) while operating profit decreased 68.1% to ₩67.6 billion ($47.7 million). Net profit also fell 58.3% to ₩70.9 billion ($50 million).
The firm's second-quarter performance fell short of previous guidance, which it attributed to "sales splits across distribution channels for Crimson Desert, regional pricing strategy differences, time lags between sell-through and revenue recognition for physical packages, and revenue deferrals for refund guarantees."
By region, North America and Europe contributed 75% of revenue, followed by Asia at 16% and Korea at 9%. By platform, PC generated 61%, console 34%, and mobile 5%. The console share stayed high, with Crimson Desert representing about 70% of total revenue.
Crimson Desert sold 2.11 million copies in the second quarter, generating ₩136.1 billion ($96 million) in revenue. Digital sales comprised 82% of total units sold, while physical copies accounted for 18%.
Pearl Abyss is developing DLC for the open-world RPG, with a release date to be announced in the third quarter. The developer is also expanding to new platforms, having reached a "playable baseline" on Nintendo Switch 2 and targeting a launch in the first half of 2027.
The Black Desert franchise generated ₩55 billion ($38.8 million), a slight decrease as operations focused on "content optimisation rather than major expansions."
Looking ahead, Pearl Abyss has updated its full-year guidance. Operating revenue is expected to range from ₩709.8 billion ($501 million) to ₩743.8 billion ($525 million), with operating profit projected between ₩315.5 billion ($222.7 million) and ₩345.2 billion ($243.6 million).
Two new titles, DokeV and Plan 8, are in development. DokeV is scheduled for release in the second half of 2028. Pearl Abyss aims to maintain a "consistent release cycle of every two to three years" for its games.

近年来，路易斯安那州
因儿童安全问题起诉了Roblox。

"未能保护儿童免受掠夺性行为的侵害，"
澳大利亚
政府也提出了类似问题。
在过去两年中，Roblox推出了新的安全功能。2024年11月，其实施了保护措施，
阻止13岁以下用户访问直接消息
并限制他们在游戏和体验中可以广播的消息。
去年11月，Roblox
引入了自愿面部识别检查
以限制未成年人与成人之间的通信。该功能
于今年早些时候在全球推出
。
去年8月添加了"敏感问题"内容标签，带有此标签的体验在
未经家长许可的情况下对13岁以下用户不可访问
。
去年6月推出了新的
审核政策和措施
，以向"用户、家长和监管机构提供更准确的信息。"Roblox还
推出了一款AI工具
，用于"检测潜在儿童危害的早期迹象。"

Students will have access to "curriculum-aligned workshops and learning resources" to develop games on the platform, including interactive Roblox Studio lesson plans.
The version of the game used is a closed environment, supervised by teachers in the classroom, with an offline version available for schools without "reliable devices or internet access."
Pupils will join offline workshops to learn game development and pitch ideas, then create a game on the Roblox platform from scratch. The firm described the course as developing practical skills in game design fundamentals, scripting in Roblox's Luau engine, and AI prompting best practices.
The company has emphasised its development of
AI-based creation tools
over the last year, which it positions as a means for users to create games more quickly.
Lesson plans align with national computing curriculum frameworks, Roblox said, with the materials used being open-source and available to download on the Digital Schoolhouse website at a later date.
"Working with Digital Schoolhouse gives us the opportunity to make new resources with established curricula experts, adding to our growing list of high-quality, immersive educational experiences," said Roblox senior director of education policy Adam Seldow.
A teacher toolkit will also be provided, including "safeguarding guidance, parent-facing materials, and curriculum alignment support." The firm described the programme materials as designed around teacher-managed classroom settings and supervised learning rather than unsupervised interaction.

introduced voluntary facial recognition checks

rolled out globally earlier this year

昨日，Xbox首席执行官Asha Sharma
到访
位于马里兰州罗克维尔的Bethesda办公室，一睹
《上古卷轴VI》

为了纪念这一时刻，美国通信工人协会（CWA）的工会成员举行了一场令人难忘的抗议活动——在办公室外放置了一只巨大的充气老鼠（
即“Scabby”——这个贬称指的是可能破坏工会成员行动的人
），并竖起了一片红旗，代表在Sharma领导下被Xbox裁掉的每一位员工。
CWA代表着大量Xbox员工，涵盖开发者、美术师、工程师、制作人、用户研究员，以及为微软旗下最大系列游戏（包括《使命召唤》、《守望先锋》、《魔兽世界》等）提供支持的客服人员。
根据OneBGS-CWA工会成员Nathan Hahn发给Game Developer的声明，此次抗议旨在迫使Sharma正视大规模裁员带来的人力成本——这种裁员已成为微软及视频游戏行业其他工作室的常态。

——首先从Obsidian、id Software和ZeniMax Online Studios等主要工作室的立即裁员开始。这标志着Xbox三年来第五轮大规模裁员。
“我们听说微软领导层本周要来我们办公室，于是决定在我们的办公室展示我们的存在感，让大家看到我们的开发者是如何受到这些毁灭性裁员影响的，”Hahn说道。
“为了展示我们的存在，我们在办公室周围贴了海报，但管理层立刻告诉我们不能在我们的隔间外侧贴海报。然后我们带进来气球，这样他们就能看到我们在这里——不过这次是在我们的隔间里面。一个由被裁开发者组成的独立团队在外面插了旗帜，每位被裁开发者一面旗。每一面旗都在公开提醒人们管理层从我们团队中裁掉了多少人——不仅仅是我们的同事和伙伴，归根结底还是我们的朋友。
“我们正在动员起来反抗这些裁员，不仅是为了确保受影响的Xbox开发者和测试人员得到公平对待，也是为了提醒我们的公司以及所有游戏工作室：这样的裁员不能继续下去。如果微软领导层没有勇气去做对我们工作室正确的事情，以制作出最好的游戏，那么我们就必须互相关爱，保护我们职业生涯和游戏行业的未来。”

Union members stage massive protest for Xbox boss Asha Sharma

'One flag for each laid off dev:' Union workers stage unmissable protest for Xbox boss Asha Sharma
It would be difficult to ignore the giant inflatable rat on the lawn.
Chris Kerr
,
Senior Editor, News
,
GameDeveloper.com
August 12, 2026
3 Min Read
Image via CWA
Yesterday, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma
paid a visit
to Bethesda's office in Rockville, Maryland, to catch a glimpse of
The Elder Scrolls VI
.
To mark the occasion, Communications Workers of America (CWA) union workers staged a rather memorable protest by deploying a giant inflatable rat (
known as 'Scabby'—a reference to the derogatory name for someone who might undermine the action of union members
) outside the office and raising a sea of red flags to represent each person laid off by Xbox under the leadership of Sharma.
The CWA represents a vast number of Xbox employees spanning developers, artists, engineers, producers, user researchers, and the customer support staff behind some of Microsoft's biggest franchises, including Call of Duty, Overwatch, World of Warcraft, and more.
According to a statement sent to Game Developer by OneBGS-CWA union member Nathan Hahn, the protest was designed to force Sharma to reckon with the human cost of the mass layoffs that have become the norm within Microsoft and other studios across the video game industry.
Related:
Meccha Chameleon tops 20M sales in two months
In July, Sharma confirmed plans to
eliminate 3,200 jobs across Microsoft's video game division
by the end of the current fiscal year—starting with immediate cuts at major studios including Obsidian, id Software, and ZeniMax Online Studios. It marked the fifth round of mass layoffs at Xbox in three years.
"We heard that Microsoft leadership was coming to our office this week, and decided to make our presence visible at the office to show how our developers have been impacted by these devastating layoffs," said Hahn.
"To show our presence, we put up posters around the office, but we were immediately told by management we couldn't have posters facing the outside of our cubes. Then, we brought in balloons so that they could see we were here, but inside our cubes this time. A separate team of laid off developers planted flags outside, one flag for each laid off dev. Each flag was a public reminder of how many people management cut from our teams—not just our colleagues and coworkers, but our friends at the end of the day.
"We're mobilizing to fight back against these layoffs not just to ensure impacted Xbox devs and testers get treated fairly, but to remind our company and game studios everywhere that layoffs like this cannot continue. If Microsoft leadership does not have the courage to do what's right for our studios to make the best possible games, it's up to us to stand up for each other and protect the future of our careers and the game industry."
Related:
Epic Games sells ArtStation and Sketchfab to KitBash
The protest came just weeks after CWA members in the United States and Canada staged numerous 'Save Our Devs' rallies outside Xbox offices in both countries. More rallies are set to be held on August 18, 2026, outside Xbox studios in Irvine, Austin, Dallas, Seattle, Albany, Rockville, Hunt Valley, Montreal, and Minneapolis.
CWA labor unions in Canada and the United States have also
taken legal action against Microsoft
for allegedly mishandling its latest round of job cuts. In July, CWA Canada president Carmel Smyth told Game Developer the company "unlawfully fired people without giving notice to or discussing it with the union."

That's No Moon，即开发中项目Crossfire的开发商，据报道已裁员14人。

该报道基于工作室员工在LinkedIn上发布的多个帖子，这些帖子从周五开始发布，此后数量不断增加。“不幸的是，我在游戏行业的第一份工作就遭遇了That's No Moon的裁员，”一位助理环境美术师写道。一位程序化技术美术师也紧随其后发帖，提到自己受到了“意外裁员”的影响。一位高级环境概念美术师表示，自己是公司报道裁员中“受影响的十四人之一”——这一数字也得到了团队中一位制作人的印证。

Gamescom Dev has released its annual speaker survey results, revealing that 83% of respondents expect AI to impact team structure or productivity.
Nearly half of the 100 speakers surveyed identified AI-assisted development as the most significant industry trend for the next three years, followed by hardware and RAM prices (28%), the creator economy (7%), and user-generated content (5%).
30% of respondents prefer minimal AI involvement in development,
down from 33% last year.
In contrast, 34% believe code and production would benefit most from AI assistance.
Regarding AI’s impact on jobs, 36% believe it will change roles rather than reduce team sizes, while 33% expect smaller teams. 14% anticipate higher individual output, and 17% do not expect workforce reductions.
More than half of respondents identified economic uncertainty as the industry’s biggest challenge, followed by market saturation (38%), discoverability (35%), and rising development costs (30%).
To improve discoverability, respondents want greater transparency in platform algorithms (32%), better storefront recommendations (22%), and more curated editorial coverage (21%).
Looking ahead, 37% of respondents view smaller development teams as the greatest opportunity, followed by community building and new publishing models (both at 15%).
Respondents expressed mixed views on what business or monetisation model would dominate the market over the next three years.
Digital and physical premium games led with 29%, followed by live service (24%) and free-to-play with in-game items (21%).

Reforj开发者4J Studios发布Rixels：改良像素可将纹理内存需求降低98%

Reforj开发者4J Studios推出了一项名为Rixels的技术，提供了一种以极小内存需求提供纹理的替代方案。这家总部位于邓迪的工作室已为该技术申请专利。

Rixels是Reforj Pixels的缩写，是一种改良像素，每个像素包含一个矢量形状——由于使用矢量图形，即使在近距离观看时也能保持清晰度。

“Rixel是我们对纹理大小问题的回应，”4J Studios董事长Chris van der Kuyl告诉GamesIndustry.biz。“我们当时使用512x512的法线纹理，也就是带有方形像素的像素网格，但随着[游戏]变得越来越大，我们意识到我们会在空间上撞墙。”

Van der Kuyl要求首席技术官Richard Reavy想出解决方案，Reavy设计了Rixels，每个Rixel包含23种矢量形状之一。矢量图形是由数学公式构建的图像，“所以无论你渲染多大尺寸，都不会出现像素化，”van der Kuyl说。

Rixels特写，每个包含一个矢量形状 | 图片来源：4J Studios

最初，4J在类似《我的世界》的游戏Reforj中使用的512x512像素网格需要4MB内存。但使用Rixels后，相同大小的网格可以由20x20的方块构成，仅需72KB内存——减少了超过98%。

“现在，当你放大时，它不会再变模糊了，”van der Kuyl说。“你会看到这些完美分辨率的漂亮小矢量形状。目前世界上除了Reforj，没有一款游戏能做到这一点。最新的邦德游戏，不管是什么，你放大纹理，到某个程度还是会变模糊。在Reforj中，完全不会。”

4J已为Rixels申请了专利，van der Kuyl对这项技术此前未被使用感到惊讶。“它看似简单，”他说。“[我们以为]肯定有人以前做过这个。但从来没有人像我们这样做到过。”

Rixels正被用于4J专有的Elements Engine中。正如创意总监Brian Gomez最近向GamesIndustry.biz解释的那样，该引擎是工作室在花费多年将《我的世界》移植到主机和掌机后，为了制作自己的沙盒游戏而开发的。

Rixels允许开发者以更少的内存存储更高分辨率的像素

van der Kuyl表示，使用Rixels节省的内存意味着Reforj可以避免性能下降。“通常，这类积木建造游戏或体素游戏很早就开始受到性能限制。所以我们问自己，我们能否构建一个在这类游戏中能持续保持每秒60帧的引擎？这可能是书呆子气的话，但对玩家来说，这将彻底改变他们的体验。”

关于潜在的授权，van der Kuyl有兴趣探索这项技术如何应用于不同媒介。

“因为我们确实发明了全新的东西，如果有人来找我们说，‘哇，我们可以把它用在图形设计工具里’，我们会很乐意授权并在其他地方使用它。但我们建造它是为了制作这个超高效的[游戏]。”

他承认这项技术可能并不适合所有作品。“它对写实风格游戏的重要性可能不如对风格化游戏那样大，”他说。但他很期待看到它在其他领域如何被使用。“看看人们会在其他情境下用它做什么，会很有趣。”

Reforj developer 4J Studios unveils Rixels: modified pixels that reduce texture memory requirements by 98% | GamesIndustry.biz
If you click on a link and make a purchase we may receive a small commission.
Read our editorial policy
.
Reforj developer 4J Studios has debuted a technology called Rixels that offer an alternative way to provide textures using a fraction of the memory requirements. The Dundee-based studio has applied to patent the technology.
Rixels, short for Reforj Pixels, are modified pixels that each contain a vector shape – and because they use vector graphics, they retain their sharpness even when viewed close up.
"The Rixel was our response to a problem with texture size," 4J Studios chairman Chris van der Kuyl tells
GamesIndustry.biz
. "We were using 512x512 normal textures, so a pixel grid with square pixels in it, but as [the game] got bigger and bigger and bigger, we realised that we were going to run ourselves into a wall with space."
Van der Kuyl challenged CTO Richard Reavy to come up with a solution, and Reavy designed Rixels, which each contain one of 23 vector shapes. Vector graphics are images built from mathematical formulas, "so no matter what size you render, it's not pixelated," says van der Kuyl.
A close-up of Rixels, each of which contains a vector shape  |
Image credit:
4J Studios
Initially, the 512x512 pixel grids in 4J's Minecraft-like game Reforj required 4MB of memory. But with Rixels, the same sized grid can be made from 20x20 squares, using only 72KB of memory – a reduction of over 98%.
"Now, when you zoom in, it doesn't get fuzzy anymore," says van der Kuyl. "You start to see these beautiful little vector shapes that exist at perfect resolution. There's not a game in the world that does this at the moment other than Reforj. The latest Bond game, whatever it is, you'll go into a texture, and it'll still get fuzzy at some point. In Reforj, it doesn't at all."
4J has applied for a patent for Rixels, and van der Kuyl is surprised the technology hasn't been used already. "It's deceptively simple," he says. "[We thought] surely somebody's done this before. And nobody's ever done it the way we've done it."
Rixels are being used in 4J's proprietary Elements Engine. As creative director Brian Gomez
recently explained
to
GamesIndustry.biz
, the engine was developed to in order for the studio to create its own sandbox games after spending years porting Minecraft to consoles and handhelds.
Rixels allow developers to store higher resoultion pixels with a smaller amount of memory
The memory saved by using Rixels means that Reforj can avoid performance dips, says van der Kuyl. "Generally, when you get these block building games, or voxel-based games, they start to get performance restrictive quite early. So we asked ourselves, could we build an engine that gave you persistent 60-frames-per-second in this kind of game? It may be a geeky thing to say, but for a player it would transform their experience."
Regarding potential licensing, van der Kuyl is interested in exploring how the technology could be applied across different mediums.
"Because we genuinely have invented something brand new, if someone came to us and said, 'Wow, we could use this in a graphic design tool', we'd love to license it and see it used elsewhere. But we've built it to make this super efficient [game]."
He acknowledges the technology might not be right for every title. "It may matter less to photorealistic games than it does to a stylised game," he says. But he's keen to see how it will be used elsewhere. "It'd be interesting to see what people would do with it in other contexts."

正文：
MTG 为其中核游戏部门揭晓全新品牌 Playamp – Mobilegamer.biz
跳至内容
MTG 已将其中核游戏部门更名为 Playamp，将 Plarium、InnoGames、Snowprint、Hutch、Ninja Kiwi 和 Futureplay 统一整合到一个全新品牌之下。
该部门此前在内部被称为“中核区”（Midcore District），涵盖 MTG 旗下以应用内购买为驱动的工作室，与围绕休闲文字游戏、以广告驱动为核心的 Playsimple 并列。
Playamp 是两者中规模远为庞大的一方：其 2025 年营收达 9.53 亿美元（瑞典克朗 90.39 亿），调整后 EBITDA 为 2.4 亿美元（瑞典克朗 22.78 亿），分别占集团总营收的 78% 和调整后 EBITDA 的 86%。
Playamp 旗下工作室打造了一系列长盛不衰的移动端热门游戏，包括《Raid: Shadow Legends》、《Forge of Empires》、《Bloons TD 6》、《Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus》、《F1 Clash》和《Merge Gardens》。
这些工作室并非以独立发行商的模式运营，而是共享一套覆盖市场营销、数据基础设施、AI 开发和面向玩家平台的中枢工具。其中最为核心的是直接面向消费者的业务推广——涵盖 MTG 自有的启动器、网页商店和用户自主选择计费方式——公司表示该渠道目前已占 Playamp 总营收的 51%，从而降低了对应用商店分发渠道的依赖。

Playamp 首席执行官 Oliver Bulloss 补充道，该部门的共享服务目前已覆盖 60 多款游戏，涉及市场营销、AI 集成和数据分析等领域。

本周，英国首相 Andy Burnham 宣布计划实施一系列“日常修复”措施，以帮助人们应对生活成本危机。其中一项提案旨在应对首相所称的“订阅陷阱”——即让人们难以取消订阅以及难以取消会以更高成本续约的合同。
作为该计划的一部分，政府表示将通过允许消费者利用新的14天冷静期，在试用或长期合同续约后取消订阅，从而让人们更容易退出订阅合同而无需承担额外费用。

Ukie seeks clarity from UK government over subscription proposals
Business
News
Ukie claims 'restrictive' subscription proposals could harm game businesses in the UK
'These changes could discourage investment in subscription products and create financial exposure for businesses.'
Chris Kerr
,
Senior Editor, News
,
GameDeveloper.com

2 Min Read
Image via Xbox
UK video game industry trade body Ukie has called on the Labour government to clarify how new consumer subscription refund proposals will impact video game companies operating in the United Kingdom.
This week, UK Prime Minister (PM) Andy Burnham announced plans to implement a series of "
everyday fixes
" to help people dealing with the cost of living crisis. That includes a proposal designed to counter what the PM described as "subscription traps" that make it difficult for people to cancel subscriptions and contracts that renew at higher costs.
As part of that plan, the government said it will make it easier for people to exit subscription contracts without incurring extra charges by allowing them to make use of a new 14-day cooling off period that will let consumers cancel after a trial or long-term contract has renewed.
In response, Ukie has asked the government to clarify how those refunds will be calculated over concerns it could allow those who make use of video game subscriptions such as Xbox Game Pass to access and consume content that exceeds the value of a refund.
Related:
Developers expect generative AI to impact roles and team sizes in the next three years
"UK games businesses need clarity in how this is going to be calculated. Subscriptions provide real benefits and value to consumers, but a narrow and restrictive method in calculating refunds could see players cancel within their renewal period having gained access and consumed content that far exceeds the value of the refund,"
reads a statement from Ukie
.
"Without flexibility and clarity from Government, these changes could discourage investment in subscription products and create financial exposure for businesses."
The fear, it seems, it that consumers could take advantage of that 14-day window to access content available through video game subscriptions—sinking hours into titles or completing them outright—before securing a refund.
As a result, Ukie has asked the government to bring forward guidance for business that could be impacted by the proposals so they can adapt their processes accordingly.

articles.title: GamesAid 任命六位新理事，2025/26年度筹集8.2万英镑
articles.summary: GamesAid在2025/26年度筹集8.2万英镑并任命六位新理事，所获资金已分配给AFK、Autistica、Rays of Sunshine Children's Charity和Solving Kids' Cancer UK四家慈善机构。这是游戏行业履行社会责任的案例，也展示了行业组织在公益和治理方面的运作方式。
articles.translated_content:
GamesAid 已任命六位新理事加入其董事会，并在2025/26年度为四家慈善机构筹集了82,000英镑。

Dom Shaw（Sussex Games 创始人）被任命为副主席，Catherine Anderson（Green Man Gaming 秘书）担任秘书，Amelia Suchy（Mom to Mum 联合创始人兼董事）担任财务主管。

Anderson 和 Suchy 接替 Mark Washbrook（Beat Games 工作室负责人）和 Gavin Smith（Arbuthnot Latham 高级商业经理），分别担任秘书和财务主管。

其他新理事包括 Greg Weller（Generation Media 游戏合作主管）、Jon Paterson（Barclays 游戏与创意创新主管）以及 Matthieu Gras（CineRPG CIC 联合创始人兼首席执行官）。

筹集的82,000英镑分配给了四家慈善机构：AFK、Autistica、Rays of Sunshine Children's Charity 和 Solving Kids' Cancer UK。每家机构获得20,500英镑。

资金通过活动、摸彩、抽奖及其他活动筹集，并于2025年5月在一场支票捐赠仪式上正式递交。

GamesAid 最近还在 Develop:Brighton 上通过“Stand Up for GamesAid”和 Mark Ward 慈善扑克锦标赛等活动筹集了30,070英镑。

借助这笔资金，AFK 为儿童提供了专业行动辅助设备，而 Rays of Sunshine 将为15名重病或临终患儿实现与游戏相关的愿望。

Autistica 正在试点一项就业准备计划，以支持神经多样性青少年，Solving Kids' Cancer UK 则正在扩展其家庭支持服务。

GamesAid 主席 Sara Veal 表示：“我们为 GamesAid 社区今年所取得的成就感到无比自豪。”

“游戏行业近期面临了重大挑战，而这么多人持续为我们的工作贡献时间、精力与支持，这意义非凡。”

“无论你是参加了我们的活动、参与了摸彩、购买了抽奖券，还是仅仅帮助宣传——每一份贡献都让这一切成为可能。我们支持的慈善机构为全英国的儿童和青少年做着非凡的工作，这笔资金将帮助它们惠及更多人。”

GamesAid has appointed six new trustees to its board and raised £82,000 for four charities in 2025/26.
Dom Shaw (founder of Sussex Games) has been appointed vice chair, Catherine Anderson (Green Man Gaming secretary) as secretary, and Amelia Suchy (Mom to Mum's co-founder and director) as treasurer.
Anderson and Suchy succeed Mark Washbrook (Beat Games' head of studio) and Gavin Smith (Arbuthnot Latham senior commercial manager) in the roles of secretary and treasurer.
Additional new trustees include Greg Weller (Generation Media head of gaming partnerships), Jon Paterson (Barclays games and creative innovation lead), and Matthieu Gras (CineRPG CIC co-founder and CEO).
The £82,000 raised was distributed among four charities: AFK, Autistica, Rays of Sunshine Children's Charity, and Solving Kids' Cancer UK. Each received £20,500.
Funds were raised through events, tombolas, raffles, and other activities. They were formally presented at a cheque-giving ceremony in May 2025.
GamesAid also recently raised £30,070 at Develop:Brighton through events including Stand Up for GamesAid and Mark Ward's Charity Poker Tournament.
With this funding, AFK provided specialist mobility equipment for children, while Rays of Sunshine will grant gaming-related wishes for 15 seriously or terminally ill young people.
Autistica is piloting an Employment Readiness Program to support neurodivergent youth, and Solving Kids' Cancer UK is expanding its Family Support Service.
"We are incredibly proud of what the GamesAid community has achieved this year," said GamesAid chair Sara Veal.
"The games industry has faced significant challenges in recent times, and it means a great deal that so many people have continued to give their time, energy and support to our work.
"Whether you attended one of our events, took part in a tombola, bought a raffle ticket, or simply spread the word – every contribution made this possible. The charities we support do extraordinary work for children and young people across the UK, and this funding will help them reach even more."

Square Enix 报告第一季度强劲增长，利润增长 175.5% 至 132 亿日元（8290 万美元）。
该公司将这一业绩归功于其数字娱乐部门，该部门在 HD Games、MMO 和智能设备/PC 浏览器子部门均实现了高销售额。

具体数据
净销售额：
784 亿日元（4.923 亿美元），增长 32.3%
营业收入：
170 亿日元（1.067 亿美元），增长 88.6%
利润：
132 亿日元（8290 万美元），增长 175.7%
数字娱乐净销售额：
499 亿日元（3.133 亿美元），增长 51.8%

要点
数字娱乐部门的营业收入增长 91.8% 至 155 亿日元（9730 万美元），主要受 HD Games 的强劲表现推动。
该子部门的净销售额增长 98.8% 至 177 亿日元（1.111 亿美元），上年同期为 89 亿日元（580 万美元）。
该子部门的营业收入增长 510% 至 61 亿日元（3820 万美元），上年同期为 10 亿日元（620 万美元）。
这些增长得益于《Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth》在 Nintendo Switch 2、Xbox Series X|S 和 Microsoft Store 上的强劲首发。该游戏最初于 2024 年 2 月在 PlayStation 5 上发布，2025 年 1 月登陆 Windows 平台。
《The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales》也推动了销售增长，同时经典游戏目录的销量也有所增加。
本季度发布的其他作品包括 Switch 2 版《Octopath Traveler》和《Octopath Traveler 2》、Switch 2 版《Star Ocean: The Second Story A》，以及《Final Fantasy X/X-2 HD Remaster》。

在 MMO 游戏子部门，净销售额增长 32.2% 至 127 亿日元（7970 万美元），而营业收入稳定在 36 亿日元（2260 万美元）。
Square Enix 表示，这些数据反映了《Final Fantasy 14》扩展包公布后“用户活跃度的提升”。该公司指出，利润“略有增长，原因是在 2027 年初计划发布之前提前确认了相关费用”。

在智能设备/PC 浏览器游戏方面，净销售额增长 35.6% 至 194 亿日元（1.218 亿美元），营业收入增长 72.7% 至 57 亿日元（3570 万美元），主要受《Dissidia Duelum Final Fantasy》和《Dragon Quest Smash/Grow》的推动。

第一季度总销量为 738 万套，高于去年的 401 万套。实体版销量为 73 万套，下载版销量为 665 万套。

展望未来，Square Enix 维持了 2026 年 5 月 14 日公布的全年综合业绩预测。

Square Enix reported strong first-quarter growth, with profit rising 175.5% to ¥13.2 billion ($82.9 million).
The company attributed these results to its Digital Entertainment segment, which saw high sales in HD Games, MMO, and Smart Devices/PC Browser sub-segments.
The numbers
Net sales:
¥78.4 billion ($492.3 million), up 32.3%
Operating income:
¥17 billion ($106.7 million), up 88.6%
Profit:
¥13.2 billion ($82.9 million), up 175.7%
Digital Entertainment net sales:
¥49.9 billion ($313.3 million), up 51.8%
The highlights
Operating income for its Digital Entertainment segment rose 91.8% to ¥15.5 billion ($97.3 million), driven by strong performance in HD Games.
Net sales in this subsegment increased 98.8% to ¥17.7 billion ($111.1 million), up from ¥8.9 billion ($5.8 million) in the prior year period.
Operating income for this sub-segment rose 510% to ¥6.1 billion ($38.2 million), compared to ¥1.0 billion ($6.2 million) in the same period last year.
These gains were driven by the strong launch of Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth on Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and the Microsoft Store. It originally launched on PlayStation 5 in February 2024 and Windows in January 2025.
Sales were also boosted by The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales, alongside increased sales in catalog titles.
Other titles released during the quarter include Octopath Traveler and Octopath Traveler 2 for Switch 2, Star Ocean: The Second Story A on Switch 2, and Final Fantasy X/X-2 HD Remaster.
In the MMO Game sub-segment, net sales increased 32.2% to ¥12.7 billion ($79.7 million), while operating income remained steady at ¥3.6 billion ($22.6 million).
Square Enix said these numbers reflected "improved user activity" following the announcement of an expansion pack for Final Fantasy 14. It noted that profits "increased slightly due to the advance recognition of expenses related to its planned release in early 2027."
For Games for Smart Devices/PC Browser, net sales rose 35.6% to ¥19.4 billion ($121.8 million), while operating income increased 72.7% to ¥5.7 billion ($35.7 million), supported by Dissidia Duelum Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest Smash/Grow.
A total of 7.38 million units were sold in the first quarter, up from 4.01 million last year. Physical sales accounted for 0.73 million units, while downloads reached 6.65 million units.
Looking ahead, Square Enix has maintained its consolidated full-year forecast for the fiscal year, as announced on May 14, 2026.
